messages.subject: measure canopy volume
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I noticed that FIELDimageR can estimate plant height using a pair of DSMs, with and without vegetation. Is it possible to use the same pair of DSMs to calculate canopy volume?

Thanks,
Brian

Warning in install.packages :
   installation of package ‘FIELDimageR_0.3.3.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status

I have already tried all the ways suggested in this post

https://community.opendronemap.org/t/about-the-fieldimager-category/4130?u=amithaldar87

And none of these suggestions have helped me, if someone has the same problem and could help me solve it, I would greatly appreciate it.

Greetings.

Jorge

messages.body_plain:
Hi
I am trying to get the field count loop to work with an automated image save of the output image. This i would like to have for veryfication and quality check of the methode.
 code I use:
dev.copy(jpeg,'C:/Users/mg/document/myplot.jpeg')
dev.off()

My problem is that the image dose not look like it should.
It look like it resize the reed dots for the count so it do not overlay with the plants counted.

Do anyone know how to solve this, or if there is a better method for autosave output images
Regards
Martin

Like having 3*3 extra plots for each plot and then only using the center plot for my analysis.
Hope it made sence
regards
Martin

messages.subject: Re: automated saving of output image from fieldcount function
messages.subject_clean: automated saving of output image from fieldcount function
messages.body_plain:
Hi Martin,

You can´t change the plotting area after pressing RUN in the function. If the image is being evaluated and you, for example, increase the plotting area the output plot will be out of reference. Try running again and not changing the plotting area and let us know... Hope it makes sense.

All the best,
Filipe

messages.body_plain:
Hi Filipe
I have solved it in another way which seems to work

mypath <- file.path("C:/Users/mg/Agrolab A S/R&D - Dokumenter/1 Running projects/Education/Emergence count/Output",paste("myplot_", pics[i], sep = ""))
    jpeg(file = mypath)#, emfPlus = FALSE
    test1.count<-fieldCount(mosaic = EX.L2$mask, fieldShape = EX.L.Shape$fieldShape, minSize = 0.007, n.core = 3)
    dev.off()

Best regards
Martin
